title: Puncture kit checks at car handover
meta_description: Check the supplied puncture kit, sealant expiry, compatible replacements and secure storage before accepting the agreed equipment.
h1: Puncture-mobility equipment: what should actually arrive with the car?
author: AutoBridge Export Editorial Team
image_alt: Three-panel editorial diagram showing three purchasing questions from the article.
image_caption: Original editorial diagram, not a photograph of a vehicle or an inspection.
summary: A tidy case beneath the boot floor can create false reassurance. The compressor may be present, the bottle may look unopened, and the moulded tray may look complete, yet the sealant can already be beyond its expiry date. A buyer who discovers that only after a puncture has bought the appearance of preparedness rather than a dependable plan.
